## Context / Problem

`_REBAR_OVERRIDES` (src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:282) family-forces
`native_structured_output: False` for Claude — a blanket signed-contract posture. E1 (recorded
on the selection bug ticket df3a, "EXPERIMENT RESULTS" comment: 39 live Bedrock calls, account
896586841071 / us-east-1) measured native structured output working under extended thinking on
specific Bedrock cells. The established mechanism for per-cell measured facts already exists:
`_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` (capabilities.py:317), an exact-id table that wins over the
family default. Enable exactly the measured cells; every other cell stays fail-closed.

Bedrock capability facts are account/region-scoped — this same epic saw a Bedrock fact
falsified on re-measurement in the project account — so each enabling row records the E1
account/region it was measured in and a re-measure trigger, and the enablement is scoped to the
exact measured ids only.

## Approach

Add `_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES` rows setting `native_structured_output: True` and
`native_output_with_thinking: True` for the cells E1 measured PASS:
`us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` (adaptive thinking) and
`us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0` (the dated profile id — the bare haiku alias 400s
at request validation; measured E1).

**Plumb `native_output_with_thinking` through EVERY `ModelCapabilities(...)` construction site
that feeds `output_mode` (currently inert — this is the load-bearing part of this story, not just
the rows).** `output_mode` (src/rebar/llm/structured.py:46) already reads
`caps.native_output_with_thinking`, and the field exists on `ModelCapabilities` (introduced by
the guard story 0fa4, fail-closed default False), BUT a `ModelCapabilities(` sweep shows THREE
live construction sites, and ALL THREE omit the field so it defaults False:

1. `_capabilities_from_profile` (capabilities.py ~:341) — omits it from both its `caps` seed
   dict and its constructor call.
2. The string-fallback path (capabilities.py ~:474-486) — omits it from its `merged` seed dict
   and its constructor call.
3. `_intersect_capabilities` (src/rebar/llm/runner.py:696) — the CONSERVATIVE record for a
   `FallbackModel` chain, fed DIRECTLY into `output_mode`; it intersects every other field with
   `all(...)` across candidates but has no `native_output_with_thinking` line, so a chain of the
   measured cells collapses the field to False and routes PromptedOutput under thinking.

(A `ModelCapabilities(` sweep also finds a fourth occurrence — the module constant
`_CONSERVATIVE` at capabilities.py:429 — but that is the intended fail-closed record and must
STAY `native_output_with_thinking=False`; the string-fallback seed reads it, so it is set
explicitly to False there for clarity, not plumbed from an override.)

So an override that sets `native_output_with_thinking: True` is silently DROPPED on all three
override-carrying paths. This story fixes all three: seed the field in the two capabilities.py dicts (profile path:
default False; fallback path: from `_CONSERVATIVE.native_output_with_thinking`) and pass
`native_output_with_thinking=bool(...)` in both those constructor calls; and add
`native_output_with_thinking=all(c.native_output_with_thinking for c in per_candidate)` to
`_intersect_capabilities` (the conservative `all` intersection, identical to every sibling field
there — a chain claims native-under-thinking only when EVERY candidate is measured to support
it). This plumbing is exactly what 0fa4 deferred by leaving the default fail-closed "until the
rows story records measured PASS cells" — it is inseparable from the rows and belongs to this
story.

Each row's comment cites its measuring run: E1 (df3a "EXPERIMENT RESULTS" — outputConfig
json_schema + thinking proven wire-legal, no 400: sonnet-4-6 adaptive, haiku-4-5 budget 2048;
account 896586841071 / us-east-1). Client-side Pydantic validators remain mandatory on the
native path — Bedrock's schema transform strips `ge`/`le` bounds (measured E1: emitted 1.0
out-of-bounds).

Explicit non-rows, recorded in the table comment: Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected server-side
by Converse structured output under thinking (provider rollout gap; re-measure trigger: rerun
the harness cell when AWS announces support). NOTE these two ids ALREADY carry a
`supports_temperature: False` row (ticket 2932/1903) — this story adds NO
native-structured-output / native-under-thinking row for them, so they remain fail-closed to
PromptedOutput; they are "non-rows" only with respect to the native-output capability.
Direct-Anthropic and OpenAI cells gain rows only from a harness matrix run measured PASS
(operator-attested artifact); cells without credentials at run time are recorded "unmeasured"
and stay prompted.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py — the measured-cell rows, the `native_output_with_thinking`
  plumbing through the two `ModelCapabilities(...)` construction sites here (profile +
  string-fallback), and the non-row comment
- src/rebar/llm/runner.py — the third construction site: `native_output_with_thinking` added to
  `_intersect_capabilities`'s `all(...)` intersection (FallbackModel chains)
- tests/unit/ (capabilities test file) — config-effect contrast tests, including a pin that the
  override actually reaches the constructed record

## Testing

Unit tier, config-effect contrast through the real capability read path (resolve model id ->
capabilities -> `output_mode`):

- `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6` with thinking=True -> NativeOutput.
- The dated haiku id (`us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0`) with thinking=True ->
  NativeOutput.
- Plumbing pin (regression pin for the review BLOCK): the constructed `ModelCapabilities` for a
  measured cell has `native_output_with_thinking is True` — a mutation dropping the field from
  ANY of the three constructor calls turns this RED (proves the override is not inert).
- FallbackModel-chain pin: a `_intersect_capabilities` over candidates that ALL support
  native-under-thinking yields `native_output_with_thinking True` (and a chain mixing a
  measured cell with a non-measured one yields False — the conservative `all`) -> output_mode
  routes NativeOutput / PromptedOutput accordingly. A mutation dropping the field from
  `_intersect_capabilities` turns the all-supporting case RED.
- String-fallback coverage: `"bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6"` passed as a STRING (not
  an object) also resolves to native_output_with_thinking True -> NativeOutput under thinking,
  so both construction paths are covered.
- `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8` (carries only the `supports_temperature: False` row, no
  native/thinking row) with thinking=True -> PromptedOutput (fail-closed negative control).
- An arbitrary unknown Claude id -> PromptedOutput (family default preserved).

All deterministic — no live boundary in this story (the live measurement is the harness story's
operator-attested artifact, already recorded; this story only encodes its result).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both measured Bedrock cells return NativeOutput under thinking through the real read path,
      on BOTH the object and string-fallback construction paths — checked by the new contrast
      unit tests.
- [ ] Opus (temperature-row-only) and unknown-id Claude cells stay PromptedOutput under
      thinking — checked by the same tests.
- [ ] `native_output_with_thinking: True` set in an override row reaches the constructed
      `ModelCapabilities` (the plumbing is not inert) — checked by a dedicated pin that goes RED
      if ANY of the three construction sites (profile, string-fallback, `_intersect_capabilities`)
      omits the field.
- [ ] A `FallbackModel` chain whose candidates ALL support native-under-thinking preserves
      `native_output_with_thinking True` (and a mixed chain collapses to False) — checked by the
      `_intersect_capabilities` contrast test.
- [ ] Every enabling row's comment cites its measurement evidence (E1 account/region + the
      wire-legal finding) and the non-row comment records the opus/4-7 re-measure trigger —
      checked in code review.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Any non-Bedrock row added under this ticket links its harness matrix
      artifact as a comment here; if none ran (this story adds only the two measured Bedrock
      rows), the non-Bedrock cells are recorded "unmeasured" in the table comment instead.
